title: GLEAM: Learning to Match and Explain in Cross-View Geo-Localization

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's prediction accuracy on positive (matching) versus negative (non-matching) cross-view image pairs to identify inherent tendencies toward classifying pairs as non-matching.

Evaluating the propagation of teacher models' linguistic patterns and superficial reasoning limitations to student models by comparing matching accuracy and explanation semantic similarity when using ground-truth-guided data curation.

Using an independent multimodal LLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash) that is completely independent of the training data sources (GPT-4o, Doubao) to score model explanations, mitigating the preference bias an LLM judge might have for its own outputs.
